h1: Custom Full Color Business Card Holders
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Business Card Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color business card holders with your logo. Ideal for trade shows and client meetings. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color printing on business card holders lets you reproduce logos, photos, and gradients with photographic detail. Unlike single-color debossing or foil stamping, full color gives you the freedom to showcase complex brand artwork directly on the holder surface. Choose from magnetic card holders, padfolios, or presentation folders that double as card storage. This option is especially effective for trade show giveaways where your booth visitors need a quick visual reminder of your brand.
heroAltText: Custom full color business card holders with printed logo on magnetic rectangle holder and padfolio
